description: Java class ApkFileProvider extending FileProvider, providing helper methods for preparing APK files and other files for installation, including generating safe URIs for different Android versions and permissions.

classes.name: ApkFileProvider
classes.description: A helper class for preparing APKs and files for installation, generating safe URIs, and managing permissions for file access during installation.

methods.name: getSafeUri
methods.description: Returns a URI for an installed APK PackageInfo, copying the APK to private storage and generating a safe URI.

methods.name: getSafeUri
methods.description: Generates a safe URI (content or file) for a given APK or file, considering Android version and expected APK.

methods.name: getSafeUri
methods.description: Generates a URI for installation, supporting both content and file schemes, and grants necessary permissions.
